content.user_title: Record Observed Citations for Buyer Questions
content.value_statement: Guessed citation lists do not show which names an answer actually attached. This skill structures observed names, a date, and a method around one buyer question.
actual_capabilities: Keep each citation record focused on one fixed buyer question.
Record names observed in association with the answer.
Include the observation date and method.
Distinguish observed names from guessed lists.
Provide an ordered checklist with a revision loop after failed scoring.
limitations: The referenced scoring script is not included, so the prescribed automated check cannot run from this package alone.
No record schema, scoring criteria, or script dependencies are supplied.
The skill does not provide browsing, citation retrieval, or independent source verification.
Each record covers one question and observation, not trends across answers or dates.

use_cases.title: Document Buyer Research
use_cases.description: Capture the names attached to an observed answer for a specific purchasing question.

use_cases.title: Track Brand Mentions
use_cases.description: Record whether a brand appeared in one buyer answer, with the observation date and method.

use_cases.title: Preserve Review Evidence
use_cases.description: Create a concise record of observed names for an answer being reviewed, without adding assumed citations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Record this buyer question: [question]. Observed names: [names]. Date: [date]. Method: [method]. Use only these observations.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Names From an Answer
prompt_templates.prompt: For [buyer question], review this supplied answer: [answer]. Record only attached names, using observation date [date] and method [method].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: extract names from supplied evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Missing Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this citation draft: [draft]. Keep one buyer question, distinguish observed from guessed names, and identify missing dates or methods.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review a draft before validation.

prompt_templates.title: Revise After Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise [draft] using [validation feedback] and [observed answer]. Preserve the question, date, and method; remove unsupported names and report unresolved issues.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: revise a record using externally supplied validation feedback.

output_examples.input: Question: Which invoicing tools suit freelancers? Observed names: LedgerKit and InvoiceDesk. Date: 2026-10-02. Method: manual review of the saved answer.
output: Buyer question: Which invoicing tools suit freelancers?
Method: Manual review of the saved answer.
Validation: Not run; the scoring script is not included.

output_examples.input: Question: Which help desk fits a small team? Observed name: HelpQueue. Additional guessed name: SupportNest. Date: missing. Method: manual transcript review.
output: Buyer question: Which help desk fits a small team?
Excluded name: SupportNest was guessed, not observed.
Observation date: Missing; required to complete the record.

best_practices: Keep the buyer question unchanged while creating and revising its record.
Provide the observed answer, observation date, and method before drafting.
Review any scoring script before execution and report unavailable validation honestly.
anti_patterns: Adding familiar brands or sources that were not observed in the answer.
Combining several buyer questions into one citation record.
Claiming successful validation when the scoring script is unavailable or has not run.

faq.question: What information belongs in a citation record?
faq.answer: Include one buyer question, names actually attached to its answer, an observation date, and the observation method.

faq.question: Does the skill discover citations automatically?
faq.answer: No retrieval tools are included. Supply the answer or observed names for the assistant to organize.

faq.question: Can I add names that probably belong in the answer?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly distinguishes observed names from guessed lists.

faq.question: Is the scoring script included?
faq.answer: No. The checklist references a Python scoring script, but the supplied package contains only SKILL.md.

faq.question: What happens when validation fails?
faq.answer: The checklist returns to recording names, date, and method, then requests another check until the script exits successfully.

faq.question: Which assistants are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Script execution still requires a separately available, reviewed script and suitable environment.
